first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making simplification the most directly aligned intervention and one likely to improve qualified revenue through earlier product value. Verify memory_86 because its prior result is central but may not establish durable revenue impact; verify memory_73 because competitor pricing makes a pricing response consequential, while its sustainability and revenue-quality effects remain uncertain. Use a guarded test focused on qualified activation and downstream revenue, not completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding, which directly addresses the 4% completion decline and 6% activation decline. The verified record shows a substantial completion lift, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Do not pursue promotional pricing: although it lifted qualified revenue 18% initially, retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Evaluate success using activation, time-to-value, 30-day retention, and qualified revenue rather than completion alone.
